subject: Governance update: slide curation, risk notes, and signoff path
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Danielle Romero <danielle@felixadvisors.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Governance update: slide curation, risk notes, and signoff path

Team —

I’m starting the governance / investor update packet curation for the July board window. Attached is a first-pass slide deck (governance-slides-v1.pptx) plus a short risk-template.xlsx we’d like each function to fill for inclusion on the risk appendix. High-level asks here: 

- Slide owners: please own the content and two rounds of edits for your assigned slides (see embedded slide notes).
- Risk notes: fill the risk-template.xlsx with current mitigations and residual risk estimate (low/med/high).
- OKR progress: one-slide heatmap summary + one example metric (top-level metric + short 1–2 sentence context).
- Timeline: please return edits and completed risk template by EOD 2027-07-14 so we can finalize for distribution on 7/16.

Attachments: governance-slides-v1.pptx, risk-template.xlsx (stubs attached to this thread).

If there are items that need explicit board-level signoff (policy changes, SLA exceptions, or a material vendor ask) call them out in your email reply so I can surface in the governance appendix.

Thanks — I’ll collect and consolidate and circulate a v2 for quick review.

—
Neha Kapoor
Head of Ops & Strategy
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Danielle Romero <danielle@felixadvisors.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Governance update: slide curation, risk notes, and signoff path

Neha —

Thanks for kicking this off. Quick notes on the ops slides (I’m volunteering to own slide 6–8 for the infra + reliability section):

- Slide 6 (Latency & SLOs): replace the stacked bar with the attached metrics-snapshot.csv (last 90 days). The tail latency callout should reference 99.9th percentile, not 99th.
- Slide 7 (Capacity & Cost): add one bullet that flags temporary Dedicated allocation for AcmeCorp pilot (estimate $15k/mo).
- Slide 8 (Incidents): keep the incident timeline but add a one-line resolution status for the May caching regression.

I’ve attached metrics-snapshot.csv for the chart source. I’ll update the deck notes and send a marked-up v1 later today.

Date: 2027-07-10T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Governance update: slide curation, risk notes, and signoff path

Hi all —

I reviewed slide 2 (OKR progress) and recommend reframing the language to be explicit about stretch targets vs committed targets. Suggested bullets for the slide: 

- Committed: revenue retention 89% (on track); monthly active customers +12% vs last quarter (on track).
- Stretch: net revenue retention target 105% (progress: 62% of stretch achieved).
- Key callouts: supply-side constraints for Dedicated in EU are delaying two mid-market deals; see infra slide (Marcus) for mitigation.

Also: can we remove the detailed product roadmap timeline from the main packet and move it to an appendix? Board prefers high-level signals only.

Thanks — I’ll inline the suggested bullet text into the deck and mark as Laura_v1.

Cc: boardsec@felixadvisors.com
Date: 2027-07-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Governance update: slide curation, risk notes, and signoff path

Neha / team —

Thanks for the early sightline. Two calendar asks from the board office: 

1) Please mark the packet final by COB 7/15 so we can distribute with the final briefing notes on 7/16.
2) Include a 1-paragraph readout on any vendor/contract changes that could affect FY28 budgeting (any spend >$50k that’s not already in plan).

Also, can you add a single-slide appendix with a short risk heatmap (low/med/high) and the top three mitigations? That will speed review for non-technical directors.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate logistics for the board room and confirm dial-in.

Danielle Romero
Partner, Felix Advisors
boardsec@felixadvisors.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Danielle Romero <danielle@felixadvisors.com>, boardsec@felixadvisors.com
Date: 2027-07-11T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated v3 and owners list — action required by 7/15 COB

Team —

Appreciate the rapid turn. I consolidated incoming edits and generated a v3 (governance-slides-v3-final.pptx) that includes:

- OKR slide rewritten per Laura’s bullets.
- Infra slides updated with Marcus’s metrics (see metrics-snapshot.csv).
- Risk appendix added (single-slide heatmap + top 3 mitigations) using the risk-template.xlsx entries so far.
- Removed detailed roadmap from the main body and placed in Appendix B.

Action items: 
- MARCUS: final check on slide 6–8 and confirm the tail-latency number by 7/14 EOD.
- LAURA: confirm OKR wording and the committed vs stretch numbers by 7/14 EOD.
- MARISSA: please add the FY28 notable vendor asks using the vendor section in Appendix A (particularly highlight any >$50k items).
- VIVEK: quick compliance note — include a one-line SOC2 audit status update on slide 3.

I’ve uploaded governance-slides-v3-final.pptx to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GOVERNANCEv2/view?usp=sharing

If I don’t hear objections, I’ll mark this final and share to the boardsec for distribution on 7/16. Please reply with a single-line "ACK" when you’ve completed your item so I can track signoffs.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Ops & Strategy
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
